@if (1==1) @if(1==0) @ELSE
@echo off
cscript //E:JScript //nologo "%~f0" %*
@goto :EOF
@end @ELSE

if (WScript.Arguments.Length != 1)
{
	WScript.Echo("URI argument expected.");
	WScript.Quit(1);
}

var uri = WScript.Arguments.Item(0);
var wsh = new ActiveXObject("WScript.Shell");

wsh.RegWrite("HKEY_CURRENT_USER\\SOFTWARE\\Classes\\{0}\\{1}", uri, "REG_SZ");

var appPath = "{2}";
var uri = WScript.Arguments.Item(0);
var wmi = GetObject("winmgmts:{impersonationLevel=impersonate}!\\\\.\\root\\cimv2");
var list = wmi.ExecQuery("Select * from Win32_Process");
var processId = 0;

for (var e = new Enumerator(list); !e.atEnd(); e.moveNext())
{
	var process = e.item()
	//WScript.Echo(process.ProcessID + ":" + process.ExecutablePath);
	
	if (process.ExecutablePath == appPath)
	{
		wsh.AppActivate(process.ProcessID);
		WScript.Echo("Process found and activated: " + process.ProcessID);
		WScript.Quit();
	}
}

var command = "\"" + appPath + "\"" + " " + uri;

wsh.run(command);
WScript.Echo("Application started: " + command);

@end
